# SD18 deterministic Human Bard level 11 Inspire widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E4/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Bard
# level-1..level-10 spontaneous arcane spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/sd13_bard_level10_progression.rs) to level 11 as chosen input only.
# It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat) and the deterministic ability/feat/performance posture from the
# level-1 through level-10 fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded
# tranche needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Bard burden surface: no
# performance-state engine (start/maintain action economy, round
# tracking/consumption), no Countersong or Distraction, no Versatile
# Performance execution, no Suggestion execution, no Dirge of Doom execution,
# no Inspire Greatness execution, no untrained-skill-use execution for
# Jack-of-All-Trades, no Lore Master take-10/take-20 execution against any
# actual Knowledge check, and no spontaneous known-spell / slot posture
# burden. The PF1 Core Rulebook Bard class table's level-11 "Special" column
# reads "Inspire competence +4, inspire courage +3, lore master 2/day"
# (verified independently against d20pfsrd and legacy.aonprd.com): Inspire
# Competence genuinely rises from +3 to +4, Inspire Courage genuinely rises
# from +2 to +3, and Lore Master's flat take-20 usage count genuinely rises
# from 1/day to 2/day — three magnitude-rises on already-grounded flat-
# constant pillars, mirroring exactly how the level-5/level-7 tier rises were
# grounded before. No new class feature (no new choice slot) is granted at
# 11th level.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-bard-level11
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:bard:11
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:12
ability=intelligence:13
ability=wisdom:8
ability=charisma:15
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:bard_bardic_knowledge:flag:enabled
choice=choice:bard_bardic_music:performance:inspire_courage
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
